long_biography.plain_text:
Biddle grew up working on his family's farm near Vittoria, Ontario, then drove trucks and learned the produce trade at the Toronto Food Terminal. He founded Scotlynn in 1993 as a carrier serving farmers and floral producers. The company linked cultivation with time-sensitive transport, using its own agricultural demand to build a wider refrigerated-freight business.

Biddle expanded Scotlynn into the United States and added third-party logistics, freight brokerage and managed transportation. The group now combines SweetPac farming and packing with cross-border trucking, partner carriers and supply-chain management. As chief executive, Biddle directs that integration. Logistics is the principal wealth engine, while agriculture supplies its original and continuing operating context.
